Corollary
Source: topping:page-0047 1. ch3:2.4\group maximum-principle

Let $g(t)$ be a Ricci flow on a closed manifold for $t\in [0,T)$. If $R\geq \alpha >0$ at $t=0$, then $T\leq \frac{n}{2\alpha }$.
